blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adversarial training is often plagued by "pseudo-attacks", perturbations that significantly increase the loss value but fail to truly alter the model's confidence structure. To address this, we propose two complementary approaches to directly attack and defend against confidence structure deformation. First, building upon the traditional loss maximization perspective, we introduce a hybrid objective that integrates cross-entropy and KL divergence, encouraging adversarial examples to simultaneously disrupt prediction accuracy and distribution consistency. Second, we geometrically reconstruct adversarial training by generating perturbations that maximize the distribution distance on the confidence manifold. Theoretical analysis shows that the optimal perturbation direction aligns with the principal eigenvectors of the Fisher information matrix. We also propose an efficient algorithm to avoid high-dimensional matrix computations. Experiments on multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that our method outperforms existing methods in adversarial robustness and robust transferability, particularly excelling in structural perturbations within high-confidence regions.
blocks.zh: 逆行训练经常被"pseudo-attacks"所困扰,扰动极大地提高了损失价值而未能真正地改变模型的信心结构. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了直接攻击和防御信任结构变形的两个补充办法。 首先,在传统损失最大化视角的基础上,我们引入了一个混合目标,将交叉内向和KL相差融合在一起,鼓励对抗性的例子同时破坏预测的准确性和分布一致性. 第二,我们几何式地重建对抗训练,产生扰动,使信心多面的分布距离最大化。 理论分析显示,最佳的扰动方向与费舍尔信息矩阵的主要编辑者一致. 我们还提出了一个高效的算法来避免高维矩阵计算. 对多套数据集和模型结构的实验表明,我们的方法在对抗力强和强力可转移性方面优于现有方法,特别是在高度自信区域的结构扰动方面。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable progress across numerous applications; however, despite their impressive performance, they remain highly susceptible to adversarial perturbations which conduct imperceptible modifications to inputs that cause incorrect predictions [ 1 ] . This vulnerability has raised significant concerns in safety–critical domains such as image recognition [ 2 ] , autonomous driving [ 3 ] , and anomaly detection [ 4 ] . Among various defense strategies, adversarial training has emerged as one of the most effective methods for improving model robustness [ 5 , 6 ] . By jointly optimizing over clean and adversarial samples, it encourages models to learn stable decision boundaries under input perturbations.
blocks.zh: 深度神经网络在许多应用领域取得了显著进展;然而,尽管其性能令人印象深刻,但它们仍然极易受到对抗性扰动的影响,这种扰动对输入进行难以想象的修改,从而导致不正确的预测[1]。 这种脆弱性在诸如图像识别[2]、自主驾驶[3]和异常探测[4]等关键安全领域引起重大关注。 在各种防御战略中,对抗性训练已成为提高模型稳健性的最有效方法之一[5,6]. 它通过共同优化清洁和对抗样品,鼓励模型在输入扰动下学习稳定的决策界限。

blocks.en: Existing adversarial training methods are commonly grouped into gradient-based approaches, optimization-based formulations, and attack-driven adversarial sample generation. Gradient-based methods such as FGSM and PGD [ 7 , 8 ] construct perturbations by following the loss gradient, offering high computational efficiency but ensuring robustness only in a local linear neighborhood. Optimization-based defenses treat adversarial training as a min–max problem and explicitly minimize the worst-case loss under bounded perturbations, often using solvers like L-BFGS [ 9 ] or zero-order optimization [ 10 ] ; however, their computational overhead is typically prohibitive for large-scale models. Meanwhile, adversarial attack–based methods [ 11 ] generate perturbed samples directly by designing black-box or white-box attacks: black-box methods rely solely on model outputs, whereas white-box attacks exploit full model gradients and internal structures.
blocks.zh: 现有的对抗性培训方法通常分为梯度法、优化式配方法和攻击驱动的对抗性样本生成法。 基于梯度的方法,如FGSM和PGD[7,8],通过遵循损失梯度构建扰动,提供高计算效率,但只确保局部线性街区的稳健性. 基于优化的防御将对抗性训练视为一个分钟-最大问题,并明确将极限扰动下最坏的情况损失降到最低,经常使用L-BFGS[9]或零级优化[10]等解答器;然而,对于大规模模型来说,其计算间接费用通常令人望而却步。 与此同时,基于对抗的攻击方法[11]通过设计黑盒或白盒攻击直接生成扰动样品:黑盒攻击方法完全依靠模型输出,而白盒攻击则利用完整的模型梯度和内部结构.

blocks.en: Prevailing adversarial training methods largely share a common heuristic: they craft perturbations by maximizing the classification loss with respect to the true label. While effective in reducing the predicted probability of the true class, this loss-centric paradigm often fails to induce meaningful, global changes in the model’s output distribution. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , even when the loss is increased, the relative ordering of confidence across classes may remain intact—a phenomenon we term pseudo-attacks. Even if the top-1 remains unchanged, the relative confidence ranking and distribution shape can still maintain local stability, meaning that the geometric vulnerability of the model near the decision boundary is not truly challenged. Such perturbations do not genuinely challenge the structural geometry of the model’s confidence manifold, leaving underlying vulnerabilities exposed.

blocks.en:
To move beyond local loss maximization, we argue that adversarial robustness should be grounded in the geometric stability of the model’s confidence distribution. In this paper, we introduce a unified adversarial training framework that operates directly on the statistical manifold of output probabilities.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: ∙ \bullet We propose an enhanced Single Point Perturbation (SPP) strategy that combines cross-entropy (CE) and Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence into a hybrid objective. Unlike prior uses of KL as a regularizer [ 12 ] , we deploy it actively during attack generation to disrupt both the top-1 prediction and the overall confidence structure. ∙ \bullet We develop a SCP framework that reformulates adversarial search as maximizing the distance between probability distributions on the confidence manifold. We show theoretically that the optimal perturbation aligns with the principal eigenvector of the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM), which captures the local curvature of the manifold. To enable scalable computation, we derive an efficient eigen-decomposition that avoids explicit manipulation of high-dimensional FIM. ∙ \bullet Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that our methods consistently improve adversarial robustness and enhance attack transferability across architectures. By directly targeting the geometric roots of model vulnerability, SCP and SPP advance the state of the art in adversarial training, offering a principled and computationally feasible path toward truly robust deep learning systems.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Adversarial Training and Geometry. Adversarial training (AT) has evolved from a local noise defense strategy into a holistic paradigm that reshapes the decision manifold of deep neural networks. Early mainstream gradient-based methods, such as FGSM [ 7 ] and PGD [ 8 ] , primarily constructed adversarial perturbations within a local ϵ \epsilon -sphere along the direction of steepest loss increase. While effective, their robustness was often limited to these direct input neighborhoods. To seek more globally stable solutions, optimization-based frameworks [ 8 , 12 ] modeled adversarial training as a minimax game. Although subsequent acceleration strategies, such as FreeAT [ 13 ] , YOPO [ 14 ] , improved training efficiency, they essentially still followed the same loss-centric heuristic. In recent years, some methods, including feature scattering [ 15 ] and MART [ 16 ] , have attempted to learn more transferable features through feature space alignment or hard example reweighting, but they often neglect the underlying geometry of the data manifold.
blocks.zh: 历代训练和几何学. 反常训练(AT)已经从局部噪声防御策略发展成一个整体的范式,重新塑造了深层神经网络的多重决定. 早期以梯度为基础的主流方法,如FGSM[7]和PGD[8],主要在最陡峭的损失增加方向上,在当地的QQ\eepsilon-圈内构建对抗性扰动. 它们的稳健性虽然有效,但往往仅限于这些直接投入区。 为了寻求更加全球稳定的解决方案,以优化为基础的框架[8,12]作为小型游戏模拟对抗训练. 尽管后来的加速策略,如FreeAT [13],YOPO [14],提高了训练效率,但基本上仍然遵循同样的以损失为中心的heuristic. 近年来,一些方法,包括特征分散[15]和MART[16],试图通过特征空间对齐或硬例子重新加权来学习更多的可转移特征,但它们往往忽略了数据复数的基本几何学。

blocks.en: Many existing approaches rely on maximizing the cross-entropy (CE) loss to measure adversarial vulnerability, while methods such as TRADES maximize distributional discrepancy during attack generation. This approach is essentially a “pointwise suppression” of the true logit, which typically fails to induce a global distortion of the model’s confidence structure. While TRADES [ 12 ] and ensemble-based approaches [ 17 ] introduce KL divergence or diversity constraints, they generally treat distributional disparity as a scalar penalty rather than a structural measure. Our work breaks with this convention by redefining adversarial perturbations as geometric transformations on the confidence manifold and asserting that true robustness stems from the manifold’s geometric stability under structural stress.
blocks.zh: 许多现有方法依赖最大限度的交叉竞争(CE)损失来衡量对抗性脆弱性,而贸易统计学等方法则在攻击生成时将分配差异最大化。 这种做法基本上是 " 点性压制 " 真正的对数,这通常不会导致该模型的信任结构的全球扭曲。 虽然贸易[12]和综合办法[17]引入了KL差异或多样性限制,但它们一般将分配差距视为一种尺度性惩罚,而不是结构性措施。 我们的工作与这项公约脱节,将对抗性的扰动重新定义为对信心的几何变化,并断言真正的强性源于结构压力下的几何稳定性。

blocks.en: Information-Theoretic Perspectives. The application of KL divergence in adversarial training has traditionally been limited to its use as a scalar measure of distributional disparity. A common practice is to use it as a consistency regularization term to balance the tradeoff between natural accuracy and adversarial robustness (e.g., TRADES [ 12 ] or gradient-smoothing approaches [ 18 ] ). Another perspective stems from knowledge distillation, where KL divergence guides distribution alignment [ 19 ] , thereby facilitating the learning of robust representations. However, most of these paradigms overlook the profound informational geometric meaning of KL divergence. Within the informational geometry framework, the KL divergence between two neighboring probability distributions is equivalent to a second-order approximation of the Mahalanobis distance defined by the Fisher information matrix (FIM).
blocks.zh: 资讯-理论视角. 在对抗性培训中应用KL差异传统上仅限于将其作为分配差异的尺度衡量。 一种常见做法是将其用作一致性规范化术语,以平衡自然准确性和对抗性之间的权衡(例如,TransportS[12]或梯度偏移法[18])。 另一种观点来自知识蒸馏,KL的分歧指导了分布的调整[19],从而便利了对强势表述的学习. 然而,这些范式大多忽略了KL差异的深刻信息几何意义. 在信息几何框架内,两个相邻概率分布的KL差等于费舍尔信息矩阵(FIM)定义的马哈拉诺比斯距离的二阶近似值.

blocks.en: Existing defense methods utilize its size for constraint but fail to fully leverage its potential as a tool for discovering structured vulnerabilities. Our research bridges this gap by transforming KL divergence from a passive regularization term into an active target for attack generation. By maximizing the manifold distance along the Fisher principal eigenvectors, we can systematically disrupt the global structure of the confidence distribution, rather than merely suppressing local outputs, forcing the model to learn a more resilient geometric representation and effectively overcoming the evaluation blind spots inherent in traditional paradigms.
blocks.zh: 现有的防御方法利用其规模加以制约,但未能充分发挥其作为发现结构性脆弱性的工具的潜力。 我们的研究弥补了这一差距,将KL的分歧从被动正规化的术语转变为攻击一代的积极目标。 通过尽量扩大Fisher主控制器的多重距离,我们可以系统地破坏信心分配的全球结构,而不是仅仅压制当地产出,迫使模型学习更具弹性的几何代表性,并有效克服传统范式中固有的评价盲点。

blocks.en: Traditional adversarial training generates perturbations by maximizing the loss function (e.g., cross-entropy CE), but such methods only locally suppress the logit of the true class, ignoring the global geometry of the confidence distribution (Fig. 1 ). We propose that true robustness should stem from the model’s stability on the confidence manifold, i.e., the input perturbation should maximize the structural deformation of the output probability distribution. To this end, we design two complementary strategies:

blocks.en: Finally, we summarize the differences between our method and TRADES: TRADES combines clean cross-entropy with a KL robustness regularizer in the training objective, and its inner maximization generates perturbations by maximizing the KL divergence between clean and perturbed predictions. SPP instead directly maximizes CE + KL in the attack generation stage, actively disrupting distribution consistency, and then uses the generated examples for standard adversarial training. SCP further replaces the gradient direction geometrically with the principal eigenvector of the FIM.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们总结了我们的方法和贸易体系之间的差异: TradeS在训练目标中将干净的跨纵横与KL稳健调节器结合,其内在最大化产生扰动,通过最大化KL在干净和扰动的预测之间的差异. SPP转而在攻击生成阶段直接最大化CE + KL,积极破坏分布一致性,然后使用生成的例子进行标准对抗训练. SCP进一步将梯度方向几何替换为FIM的主精度.

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the relationship between model geometry and attack resistance, we conduct experiments on representative architectures with distinct structural characteristics: ∙ \bullet ResNet [ 23 ] : It introduces residual connections, allowing gradients to bypass nonlinear layers directly. Skip connections stabilize the gradient flow, reduce gradient vanishing/explosion, and reduce variance, so its maximum eigenvalue is relatively low. ∙ \bullet DenseNet [ 24 ] : Each layer of DenseNet receives the output of all previous layers as input. With more gradient paths and gradients dispersed to each layer, its variance is potentially the smallest among the considered models. ∙ \bullet ViT [ 25 ] : Vision Transformer (ViT) is based on the self-attention mechanism, which causes the gradient to involve global interactions, potentially introducing large variance; however, LayerNorm and residual connections help stabilize the gradient.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估模型几何学与攻击阻力之间的关系,我们对具有不同结构特征的代表性建筑进行实验:\bullet ResNet [23]: 它引入了剩余连接,允许梯度直接绕过非线性层. 跳过连接稳定梯度流,减少梯度消失/爆炸,并减少差异,因此其最大eigen值相对较低. *\bullet DenseNet [24]: DenseNet的每层都收到前几层的输出作为输入. 由于梯度路径和梯度分散到每一层,其差异可能是所考虑的模型中最小的。 *\bullet VIT [25]:远景变换器(ViT)是基于自觉机制,它导致梯度涉及全球相互作用,可能带来巨大的差异;然而,LayerNorm和剩余连接有助于稳定梯度。

It is worth noting that for the above three measurements, using the ADV under AutoAttack, we have the following relationship ASR = 1 − ADV STD \mathrm{ASR}=1-\frac{\mathrm{ADV}}{\mathrm{STD}} .

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison on attack metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 攻击指标比较

blocks.en: We compare our SCP algorithm with state-of-the-art (SOTA) adversarial training methods on three widely used image classification datasets (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet) using ResNet18, ResNet34, and ResNet50 [ 23 ] as baseline models. These architectures were chosen as the common intersection of models used in recent adversarial training literature, balancing computational efficiency and representativeness. Adversarial examples are generated with a perturbation budget ( ϵ 2 \epsilon_{2} ) customized for each dataset and the performance is evaluated using STD, ADV, and ASR, where lower ASR indicates higher robustness.
blocks.zh: 我们用ResNet18、ResNet34和ResNet50[23]作为基线模型,将我们的SCP算法与三个广泛使用的图像分类数据集(CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet)的先进对抗训练方法进行比较。 这些架构被选为最近对抗性训练文献中使用的模型的共同交叉点,平衡了计算效率和代表性. 用一个扰动预算(ε 2\epsilon _{2})为每个数据集定制而生成了负面的例子,并且使用STD,ADV,ASR来评价性能,其中较低的ASR表示强性更高.

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of adversarial training methods on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet. Red : best; blue : second best.
blocks.zh: 表1:关于CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet的对抗性训练方法比较。 红:最好;蓝:第二好.

blocks.en: Driven by its geometric approach to perturbing the belief manifold rather than traditional scalar loss optimization, SCP demonstrates competitive performance, particularly on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets. As shown in Table 1 , SCP frequently achieves the highest robust accuracy under AutoAttack (AA). For instance, on CIFAR-10 with ResNet-50, SCP achieves an AA of 72.50 % 72.50\% , surpassing SPP ( 70.99 % 70.99\% ) and significantly outperforming baseline methods. Conversely, SPP exhibits superior performance on the Tiny-ImageNet dataset. Across all three ResNet architectures on Tiny-ImageNet, SPP yields higher Standard Accuracy (STD) than SCP. Its Attack Success Rate (ASR) is lower on ResNet-18 and ResNet-50; on ResNet-34, SPP has an ASR of 30.69 % 30.69\% , compared with SCP’s 28.89 % 28.89\% .
blocks.zh: 在其几何方法的推动下,在对信仰进行多重而不是传统的分级损失优化的推动下,SCP展示了竞争表现,特别是在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上。 如表1所示,SCP经常在AutoAttack(AA)下达到最高的强性精度. 例如,在使用ResNet-50的CIFAR-10上,SCP取得了72.50%72.50%的AA,超过了SPP(70.99%70.99%70.99%),并大大超过了基准方法。 相反,SPP在Tiny-ImageNet数据集上表现出优异的表现. 在Tiny-ImageNet上的所有三个ResNet架构中,SPP的产量标准精确度(STD)高于SCP. 其攻击成功率在ResNet-18和ResNet-50上较低;在ResNet-34上,SPP的ASR为30.69% 30.69 % ,而SCP的为28.89% 28.89 % 。

blocks.en: From a dataset perspective, SCP consistently minimizes the Attack Success Rate (ASR) compared to traditional methods like PGD and TRADES, validating its focus on structured belief perturbations over heuristic input space attacks. This advantage is most performed on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100. For example, using the ResNet-50 architecture on CIFAR-10, SCP achieves a remarkable ASR of 12.90 % 12.90\% , which is a substantial improvement over TRADES ( 19.34 % 19.34\% ) and PGD ( 17.10 % 17.10\% ). Even on the more challenging CIFAR-100 dataset, SCP maintains this robust superiority; with ResNet-50, it suppresses the ASR to 24.59 % 24.59\% , whereas competitive baselines like MIFGSM and PIFGSM struggle with ASRs of 29.65 % 29.65\% and 30.32 % 30.32\% , respectively.
blocks.zh: 从数据集的角度来看,与PGD和TradeS等传统方法相比,SCP始终将攻击成功率(ASR)降到最低,验证了它对结构化的信仰扰动相对于热输入空间攻击的关注. 这一优势主要表现在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上. 例如,在CIFAR-10上使用ResNet-50架构,SCP取得了显著的12.90%的ASR(12.90% ) , 这比TradeS(19.34% 19.34% ) 和PGD(17.10% 17.10% ) 有了更具挑战性的CIFAR-100数据集,SCP保持了这种强大的优势;在ResNet-50上,SCP压制了24.59%的ASR(24.59% 24.59% ),而MIFGSM和PIFGSM等竞争性基线则分别与29.65% 29.65%的ASR和30.32%的ASR(30.32% )相抗衡。

blocks.en: The proposed methods, SPP and SCP, perform exceptionally well across varying model depths: ResNet-18, ResNet-34, and ResNet-50, demonstrating that the geometric disruption of the belief manifold scales effectively with network complexity. Unlike SOTA baselines such as PIFGSM, which witness a performance drop as model depth increases (e.g., dropping to 40.83 % 40.83\% STD on CIFAR-100/ResNet-50), the proposed methods exhibit enhanced adversarial resilience without suffering catastrophic drops in standard accuracy. On CIFAR-10/ResNet-50, both SPP and SCP maintain high clean accuracy (STD) of 83.12 % 83.12\% and 83.24 % 83.24\% respectively, while simultaneously securing the highest CW-10 and AA scores in the comparison.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法,即SPP和SPP,在不同的模型深度方面表现特别出色:ResNet-18、ResNet-34和ResNet-50,表明信仰多重尺度的几何学干扰与网络的复杂性是有效的。 与诸如PIFGSM等SOTA基线不同的是,在模型深度增加(例如,在CIFAR-100/ResNet-50上下降到40.83%/40.83%/%STD)时,拟议方法显示出增强对抗力,而不会使标准准确性出现灾难性下降。 在CIFAR-10/ResNet-50上,SPP和SCP都分别保持83.12%83.12\%和83.24%83.24\%的高清精度(STD),同时在比较中获得CW-10和AA最高分数.

blocks.en: On Tiny-ImageNet, SCP has lower STD than SPP at all three depths and higher ASR at two of the three depths. We attribute this behavior to three factors. First, the large number of classes (200) inflates the estimation variance of the Fisher Information Matrix, degrading the accuracy of its principal eigenvector. Second, the underfitting on this dataset may violate SCP’s assumption of a well-converged confidence manifold, making its single-step perturbation unreliable. Third, SPP’s multi-step signed gradient updates are inherently more robust to gradient noise and do not rely on explicit geometric estimation, offering greater stability under challenging training conditions.
blocks.zh: 在Tiny-ImageNet上,SCP在所有三个深度都有低于SPP的STD,在三个深度中的两个深度有更高的ASR. 我们将此行为归于三个因素. 首先,大量类别(200个)夸大了Fisher信息矩阵的估计差异,降低了其主要编辑者的准确性。 第二,这一数据集的不完善可能违反SCP关于信任程度良好假设的多重性,使其单步扰动不可靠。 第三,SPP的多步签名梯度更新在本质上比梯度噪声更强,不依赖明确的几何估计,在挑战性训练条件下提供了更大的稳定性.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , the proposed methods remain highly competitive against recent adversarial training baselines under the AutoAttack evaluation. SCP achieves the best robust accuracy of 70.47 % 70.47\% , while SPP obtains the second-best result of 70.15 % 70.15\% , both surpassing the strongest non-ours baseline GAWP ( 68.89 % 68.89\% ). blocks.en: 4.5 Cross-architecture evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.5 跨建筑评价

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the relationship between model geometry and attack resistance, we conduct experiments on representative architectures with distinct structural characteristics, as shown in Table 3 :
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估模型几何学和攻击阻力之间的关系,我们对具有明显结构特征的代表性建筑进行实验,如表3所示:

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of DenseNet121 and ViT-B/16 on CIFAR-10. Red : best; blue : second best.
blocks.zh: 表3:关于CIFAR-10的DenseNet121和Vit-B/16的比较。 红:最好;蓝:第二好.

blocks.en:
For DenseNet121, both SPP and SCP maintain their superiority, with SCP achieving an outstanding STD of 82.49% and a robust AA of 69.79%. This aligns with our expectations: DenseNet’s dense skip connections disperse gradient flow across layers, effectively minimizing gradient variance and providing a stable, smooth geometric manifold that perfectly suits our covariance-based perturbation estimation.
Conversely, on the ViT-B/16 architecture, we observe a systemic performance degradation across all evaluated adversarial training methods, including our SPP/SCP and established baselines like TRADES and PIFGSM. The standard accuracy (STD) and robust accuracy (AA) for all methods drop significantly compared to their CNN counterparts. We attribute this phenomenon to two fundamental conflicts between the ViT architecture and current gradient-based adversarial training paradigms: ∙ \bullet Lack of Local Inductive Bias and Severe Underfitting: Unlike CNNs, ViTs lack translational invariance and local inductive biases. They are notoriously data-hungry and prone to severe underfitting when trained from scratch on small-scale datasets like CIFAR-10. Introducing strong adversarial constraints (whether through TRADES’ KL-divergence or our geometric manifold perturbations) acts as an excessive regularization that further chokes the model’s representation capacity, leading to the observed collapse in STD. ∙ \bullet High Gradient Variance and Manifold Instability: ViTs rely heavily on global self-attention mechanisms, meaning that spatial perturbations interact globally across the entire image patch sequence. This global interaction induces highly non-local and high-variance gradients. Since almost all current adversarial training methods (especially our SCP, which relies on the Fisher Information Matrix for local geometric approximation) depend on stable local gradient information, the noisy gradient landscape of ViT causes the estimated worst-case perturbation directions to become highly inaccurate. This instability explains why neither traditional PGD-based methods nor our covariance-guided framework can achieve optimal robustness on Vision Transformers without specialized architectural adaptations.
blocks.zh:
对DenseNet121来说,SPP和SCP都保持其优越性,SCP取得了82.49%的杰出性病和69.79%的强效性病。 这符合我们的期望:DenseNet的密集跳过连接分散了梯度流跨层,有效地将梯度差异降到最低,并提供了稳定、平滑的几何倍数,完全适合基于共变的扰动估计。
相反,在Vit-B/16架构方面,我们看到,所有经评价的对抗性培训方法,包括我们的SPP/SPP以及诸如TradeS和PIFGSM等既定基线,都出现了系统性的绩效退化。 所有方法的标准精度(STD)和强度精度(AA)与CNN对应方法相比大幅下降. 我们将此现象归因于ViT架构与目前基于梯度的对抗性训练模式之间的两个根本冲突:\bullet 缺少本地的诱导性偏差和严重不足:与CNN不同,ViTs缺乏翻译偏差和本地的诱导性偏差. 在CIFAR-10等小型数据集上从头到尾接受训练时,它们非常缺乏数据,而且容易严重不适应。 引入强烈的对抗性限制(无论是通过贸易部的KL-潜水还是通过我们的几何多重扰动)是一种过度的正规化,进一步扼杀了模型的表达能力,导致所观察到的性病崩溃。 *\bullet 高梯度差异和操纵不稳定性:ViTs严重依赖全球自觉机制,这意味着空间扰动在整个图像补丁序列中在全球范围内相互作用。 这种全球互动导致高度非局部和高度变化梯度。 由于几乎所有现行的对抗性训练方法(尤其是我们依靠费舍尔信息矩阵进行局部几何近似)都依赖于稳定的局部梯度信息,因此ViT的吵闹梯度地貌使得估计最坏情况扰动方向变得高度不准确. 这种不稳定性解释了为什么传统的基于PGD的方法和我们的共同指导框架都无法在没有专门的建筑改造的情况下在Visual Transformers上实现最佳的稳健性。

blocks.en: 4.9 Visualization of the confidence shift

blocks.en: To validate the primary motivation of our Structured Confidence Perturbation (SCP) framework—specifically,we utilize t-SNE [ 42 ] to project the high-dimensional latent features from the penultimate layer of a ResNet-18 model into a 2D coordinate system ( X X and Y Y axes). Figure 3 illustrates the distribution shift between clean samples and adversarial examples generated by CW [ 26 ] and our SCP method on the CIFAR-10 dataset.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , benign samples (represented by blue points) cluster into distinct regions and reside on a high-confidence plateau, with Z Z -axis values consistently near 1.0. This phenomenon confirms the existence of pseudo-attacks , where the perturbation fails to disrupt the model’s belief structure fundamentally. In contrast, our SCP method induces a much more radical deformation of the confidence landscape (represented by red points). The confidence scores for SCP-generated samples drop sharply, indicating that our method effectively explores the most vulnerable regions of the statistical manifold.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We address the “pseudo-attack” problem using two complementary approaches—Single Point Perturbation (SPP) and Structured Confidence Perturbation (SCP)—systematically attacking and strengthening the model’s confidence structure stability from two levels: local sample-level perturbation and global manifold-level deformation, respectively. SPP integrates a hybrid loss function combining CE and KL, while SCP further models adversarial perturbation as a distance maximization problem on the confidence manifold from an information geometry perspective. SCP’s scalable computation makes it suitable for large-scale classification tasks. Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves adversarial robustness on multiple standard datasets and model architectures. Visualization analysis further confirms that SCP effectively induces global deformation of the confidence distribution, preventing adversarial examples from remaining in high-confidence regions. Future research directions include exploring its potential to improve robustness in generative models and self-supervised learning.
blocks.zh: 我们利用两种相辅相成的方法——单一点扰动和结构化建立信任扰动——系统地从两个层次攻击和加强模型的信任结构稳定性:地方抽样层扰动和全球多层次变形。 SPP将混合损失函数结合了CE和KL,而SCP则从信息几何角度进一步将对抗性扰动作为置信多面的距离最大化问题. SCP的可扩展计算使其适合大规模分类任务. 实验结果表明,拟议方法大大提高了多种标准数据集和模型架构的对抗力。 可视化分析进一步证实,SCP有效诱导信心分布的全球变形,防止对抗性例子留在高自信地区. 未来的研究方向包括探索其提高基因模型和自我监督学习的稳健性的潜力.
